user.title: Praktor
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to Praktor with the URL and chat token shown by the Praktor App.

data_description.url: Base URL of the Praktor chat API, as logged by the Praktor App, for example http://local-praktor:8080.
data_description.chat_token: Chat token generated by the Praktor App. It only grants access to the chat endpoint.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Praktor
reauth_confirm.description: Praktor at {url} no longer accepts the stored chat token. Enter a new one.

error.invalid_url: Enter an http:// or https:// URL without credentials, query string or fragment.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while talking to Praktor.

abort.already_configured: This Praktor instance is already configured.

data_description.agent: Agent to send messages to. Leave empty to use the first agent allowed for the chat token, which is claude by default.
data_description.timeout: How long Praktor may wait for the agent to reply, in seconds.

ask.name: Ask Praktor
ask.description: Send a message to a Praktor agent and return its reply.

message.name: Message
message.description: The message to send to the agent.

agent.name: Agent
agent.description: Name of the Praktor agent to ask. Defaults to the agent configured in the integration options, or Praktor's first allowed agent.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long Praktor may wait for the agent to reply, in seconds. Defaults to the timeout configured in the integration options.

config_entry_id.name: Praktor instance
config_entry_id.description: The Praktor integration to use. Defaults to the first loaded Praktor integration.

no_config_entry.message: No Praktor integration is loaded. Add Praktor before calling this service.

entry_not_found.message: The selected Praktor integration is not loaded.

timeout_error.message: Praktor did not reply in time.

forbidden.message: This agent isn't allowed for the chat token. Check web.chat_agents in Praktor.
